_about: WALKPROBE v1 (laneWALKAUDIT), read by Assets/Scripts/Zones/WalkProbe.cs. enabled=false: the probe does not exist unless the launch flag -walkProbe is given. Grid in world metres; one run, startAfterS after scene load, while the player stands in the zone to test (rings that are off show as RING_OFF_HOLE). Output: walk_probe.csv in outDir (or -walkProbeOut:<dir>, default persistentDataPath) + [WalkProbe] lines in the player log. walkY = the walking plane (GroundCollider top y 0), walkTolM = tolerated floor deviation, capsule* = the fighter capsule for the blocked-forward cast, stepM = how far forward each cell tests.
